method: Actual fetch_external_page calls during resumed review; extracted landing/metadata text only. No upstream numerical dataset comparison or boundary validation.

sources.population: Indicator title, listed upstream providers and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.growth: Annual-percent indicator title, derived-from-population attribution and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.birth: Per-1,000-people indicator title and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.death: Per-1,000-people indicator title and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.migration: Net migration indicator title, UN WPP attribution and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.life: Life expectancy at birth, total (years) indicator title and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.older: Ages 65 and above share indicator title and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.younger: Ages 0-14 share indicator title and CC BY-4.0 label read; values not compared.
sources.wpp: Landing title only; extracted response had no substantive body. WPP numerical release and download paths not verified in this retry. Prior undocumented 404 claims removed.
sources.wup: Landing body identifies 2025 Revision and consistency with WPP 2024; city values not compared.
sources.geo: About body describes aggregation, editable records and creative-commons attribution; record dates/populations not validated.
sources.growth_method: World Bank metadata explicitly defines exponential midyear growth r=ln(pn/p0)/n; not discrete geometric growth.
sources.birth_method: World Bank metadata defines annual live births per 1,000 midyear population; exposure denominator and natural increase explained.
sources.life_method: World Bank metadata defines period life-table expectancy under fixed age-specific mortality; not an individual's experienced cohort lifespan.
sources.wup_method: UN definition-issues page explains changing physical extent, administrative boundaries and historical definition consistency; no polygon validation.
sources.urban_definition: European Commission GHSL definition page states 1 km2 grid cells, population density, contiguity and population size dimensions; numerical thresholds not asserted.
sources.geo_terms: GeoNames export terms show cc-by attribution and as-is/no accuracy, timeliness or completeness warranty; fetched text does not establish licence version.

additionalLink.scope: Deed - Attribution 4.0 International title and canonical URL only; no legal certification.
